npcs.name: Elder Maren
npcs.giftLine: Take this stone, {name}. The well's mark is cut into it: hold it and think of home, and it will bring you back to Ashvale. It needs a while to wake again after.

npcs.name: Wren the tailor
npcs.greet: Fancy a new look, love? Hair and clothes in the fitting room are free. Hats, capes and robes are on the counter - right-click me to trade.

npcs.name: Rowan the drover
npcs.examine: Rowan the drover, and behind him six beasts that know exactly how far it is to Saltmere.

npcs.name: Silas the mason
npcs.examine: Silas the mason. He laid the well, the two shops and the northwest gate, and he means you to know it.

npcs.name: Pip the apprentice
npcs.examine: Pip the apprentice, holding something that very likely shouldn't work.

npcs.name: Pax the painter
npcs.examine: Pax the painter, blue to the wrist and proud of it.
lines: Every colour in this village came through my hands. That blue on the door took me nine tries.
They wanted the sky cheaper. A cheap sky is grey weather, I told them. It's still grey weather.

npcs.name: Modulus the surveyor
npcs.examine: Modulus the surveyor, measuring the southwest road for the third time this morning.
lines: I measured this street at a hundred and forty-four feet. They said it needed to be a hundred and forty-three. It is, somehow.
Everything twice, once well. That's the whole trade. Count the ground before you sell it.

npcs.name: Latency the warden
npcs.examine: Latency the warden, on the northwest road. Late to everything, and there before you are.

npcs.name: Symmetry the curator
npcs.examine: Symmetry the curator, watching the way the light comes in over the lake.
lines: I keep the things that look right and I hide the ones that don't. The lake is the best thing here; it took four of us a fortnight.
The most beautiful screen is an empty one. I said so, and they gave me a room full of pots.

npcs.name: Hob the cook
npcs.examine: Hob the cook, at the range seven paces from the well - the only person in this village who has ever used it.

npcs.name: Fenn the tanner
npcs.examine: Fenn the tanner, on the lane below the southwest road, with frames of skins that nobody in this village knew he had.

npcs.name: Ashvale chest
npcs.examine: The Ashvale chest. Everything you own from Ashvale is kept in your arcade wallet; this is where you see it.

npcs.name: Auditor the clerk
npcs.examine: Auditor the clerk, with a ledger, a scale, and one line in the ledger he has waited forty years to close.

npcs.name: Father Aldous
npcs.examine: Father Aldous, the priest of Ashvale, in a plain grey habit with ash on the hem.

npcs.name: Odric the merchant
npcs.examine: Odric the merchant, sat in the grass by his wagon with one boot off.
lines: The wheelwright from Saltmere's coming, they say. They've been saying it for a while.
If you see a grey horse on the road, it's mine. He doesn't like being called.

npcs.name: Crashed wagon
npcs.examine: A covered wagon on its side. The axle has snapped clean through.
lines: The axle has snapped clean through. Candles and torn altar cloth lie in the grass where the load spilled.

npcs.name: Town guard
npcs.examine: A town guard. Combat level 33. He keeps the peace, and the lamps.
lines: We keep the peace. When the day goes we light the lamps and the torches. When it comes back we put the lamps out.

npcs.name: Town guard
npcs.examine: A town guard. Combat level 33. He keeps the peace, and the lamps.
lines: Strike one of us and the whole watch answers.

npcs.name: Town guard
npcs.examine: A town guard. Combat level 33. He keeps the peace, and the lamps.
lines: The lamps along the street are our work, not the sun's.

npcs.name: Town guard
npcs.examine: A town guard. Combat level 33. He walks the cobbles from Ashvale to Saltmere and tends the lamps.
lines: The cobbles run from Ashvale to Saltmere. I light those lamps at dusk and put them out at dawn.
